name.zh: 扶椅站姿股四头肌拉伸

purpose.en: Stretch the front of your thigh.

text.zh: 手抓脚踝，脚跟靠近臀部，骨盆后卷
text.en: Hold your ankle, bring your heel toward your glute and tuck your pelvis

text.zh: 单腿站直，一手扶椅背保持平衡
text.en: Stand tall on one leg with a hand on the chair for balance.

text.zh: 双膝并排，不要向外打开
text.en: Keep your knees side by side, not flaring out.

commonErrors.en: Letting the knee drift out or forward.

cautions.zh: 膝盖疼痛时减小屈膝幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Bend the knee less if it hurts, and stop if the pain continues.
